study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: Physical activity levels during pregnancy (measured using the Kaiser Physical Activity Survey)
outcome: Duration of second stage of labor
cohort: 811 women with singleton pregnancies without a major fetal anomaly at full-term gestation admitted for labor induction or spontaneous labor
finding: While there was no difference in the duration of the second stage of labor, women with higher physical activity levels during pregnancy had a shorter duration of active labor and were less likely to have a prolonged first stage of labor.
